mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, measure_time, steps, duration_seconds FROM t_sports_record WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_sports_record (user_id, measure_time, steps, duration_seconds) VALUES (#{userId}, #{measureTime}, #{steps}, #{durationSeconds})
